svg.title: Swimming instructor — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as swimming instructor, wearing a sports top. Visible work cue: Swimming goggles sit above a rounded training kickboard and a clearly separate water ripple. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face.
